description: NaYTiNbO₆F crystallizes in the tetragonal P4_122 space group. Na is bonded to six O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.59-2.73 Å. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.27 Å. Y is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.76 Å. Both Y-F bond lengths are 2.25 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-48°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.02 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-48°. There are two shorter (1.99 Å) and four longer (2.01 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Y and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Y atoms to form corner-sharing FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra.
